metadata.title: FVS-ACD v12.11 benchmark: six Acadian growth and yield model generations against OSM-ACD v2.26.1, with a measured-height coverage census

creators.name: Weiskittel, Aaron
creators.affiliation: Center for Research on Sustainable Forests, University of Maine

metadata.description:
An independent benchmark of FVS-ACD, the Acadian variant of the Forest Vegetation Simulator, covering six model generations (v12.5.0, v12.7.0, v12.7.1, v12.9.x, v12.10.1 and the v12.11 candidate) against the native Acadian competitor OSM-ACD v2.26.1, scored throughout on the FIA National Scale Volume and Biomass system. The deposit carries the full benchmark report, the variant overview GTR, the principal scorecards behind the reported numbers, and the scripts that produce them.

Scope of comparison. Two populations are reported and are kept separate because they were never scored as one. The legacy in-domain set (n = 705, New Brunswick plus ESI-covered Quebec) carries the generational comparison through v12.10.1 and OSM. The multi-source all-sites benchmark (5,754 stands across Maine, New Brunswick and Quebec, plus 4,504 independent Nova Scotia stand-pairs) carries the v12.11 candidate against the frozen base and OSM. Neither model is a clean overall winner: v12.11 is the more consistent performer and leads its targeted managed and mature strata and biological realism, while OSM leads pooled precision and the unmanaged and short-interval cells.

Benchmark integrity. A measured-height coverage census across all eleven staged sources is included and is the reason several conclusions are stated narrowly. The scoring harness substitutes a diameter-only height curve wherever a tree lacks a measured height, and coverage ranges from 4.02 percent of t2 basal area at the Penobscot Experimental Forest to 100 percent at SILC long. The curve runs 12 to 33 percent short on hardwood on every source large enough to be informative, while its softwood direction varies by source, so pooled checks can conceal it. Rescores under a fitted group curve are supplied as a validated sensitivity beside the published numbers, which are retained unchanged; model orderings are durable under every height treatment even where levels are not.

The lead visual (00_FVS-ACD_v1211_graphical_abstract.png) is the graphical abstract. Aggregates only. No FIA true plot coordinates appear in any file, including code and figures, and no proprietary per-stand provincial or ownership data is included.
